title: Seller Listing Coverage Schedule, Real Estate Service Contracts
content:
Seller listing coverage on the Real Estate Service Contracts plans is set per plan by the figures below: whether it is available at all, how long it runs, how it may be extended, the limits that apply to it, whether heating, cooling and ductwork are within it, and the payment period for a failed-sale charge.

## Seller coverage figures by plan

| Figure | Bridgewell Closing Starter | Bridgewell Closing Standard | Bridgewell Closing Plus | Bridgewell Closing Premier | Bridgewell Closing Premier Two-Year | Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Seller listing coverage available with a listing order | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Seller coverage period from the order date before any extension (calendar days) | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 0 |
| Days one listing extension adds to the listing coverage end date | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 0 |
| Maximum listing extensions per order | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 0 |
| Limit per covered item during seller listing coverage | $1500.00 | $1500.00 | $1500.00 | $2000.00 | $2000.00 | $0.00 |
| Total limit for all seller listing coverage claims on the order | $3000.00 | $3000.00 | $3000.00 | $4000.00 | $4000.00 | $0.00 |
| Heating, cooling and ductwork covered during seller listing coverage | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Failed-sale charge payment period (calendar days after the charge is billed) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

## Points of reading

- The Bridgewell New Construction Three-Year plan offers no seller listing coverage: its seller coverage period, extension days, extension count and seller limits are all zero.
- On the Bridgewell Closing Starter plan, heating, cooling and ductwork are outside seller listing coverage; on the four other Bridgewell Closing plans they are within it.
- The per-item limit and the total limit are separate figures: on the Bridgewell Closing Premier plan a single item is limited to $2000.00 while all seller-phase claims on the order together are limited to $4000.00.
- With one extension of 90 days, a listing order on a Bridgewell Closing plan can carry seller coverage for at most the 180-day period plus 90 days.

## Illustration (hypothetical claims)

On a hypothetical Bridgewell Closing Standard listing order, work on a first item costing $1800.00 is above the per-item limit of $1500.00, so at most $1500.00 is available toward that item; a second item whose work costs $1200.00 is within its own per-item limit, and the two amounts together ($2700.00) are within the total limit of $3000.00.
